checks.name: No tiny fixed pixel font sizes
Do not block pinch-zoom on mobile

cannotTest: Whether a screen is genuinely mobile-first, desktop-aware and tablet-optimised, looks custom-made on each device, stays DRY, and has comfortable visibility, font sizing and hit areas (e.g. touch targets of at least 44px, sensible breakpoints, a tablet layout) needs a reviewer to judge; only tiny fixed pixel font sizes and zoom-blocking viewport settings can be detected automatically.
